blocks.text:
Day 5 · From Poroy or Río Sagrado station, board the exclusive Hiram Bingham deluxe train for one of the most spectacular rides in the world. The experience on board is pure first class: classic style, an elegant dining car and dishes carefully prepared by experienced chefs, while breathtaking landscapes unfold along the Urubamba River towards Aguas Calientes. From there, a small bus climbs the winding road to Machu Picchu, the Lost City of the Incas, with its terraces, ceremonial shrines, stairways and the Intihuatana solar clock, on a guided tour. Tea time at the Sanctuary Lodge; overnight at a hotel in Aguas Calientes or at Machu Picchu.

Day 6 · Breakfast and a free morning, with the possibility of a second visit to Machu Picchu, to the Intipunku or Sun Gate, where the Inca Trail enters the citadel. Entrance tickets to Machu Picchu, and the daily spots to climb Huayna Picchu, are limited and must be booked in advance, at the time you book the programme. At the arranged time, return to Cusco on the Hiram Bingham, with a gourmet dinner on board, and transfer to the hotel.

blocks.text: Day 4 · Breakfast. In the morning, visit Sacsayhuamán, an impressive fortress of colossal constructions set amid beautiful views, then the Inca shrine of Q’enqo, with its sacrificial altar carved inside a rock cave, the Puka Pukara viewpoint and Tambomachay, a monument of remarkable architecture considered one of the pillars of the Andean worldview. Free afternoon to explore the city.
